title: Does local learning preserve plasticity? Forward-Forward versus backpropagation in continual learning — code and results
description: Code, Colab notebooks and per-task results for the manuscript 'Does local learning preserve plasticity? Forward-Forward versus backpropagation in continual learning' (submitted to Neural Networks). Includes the experiment library (PyTorch), five notebooks (control regime; main random-label regime with BP-N control and width ablation; Forward-Forward learning-rate sensitivity; robustness with SGD and a convolutional network; other local rules and Continual CIFAR-100), per-task metrics of every run (JSON Lines), configuration files, and a script that rebuilds every table and figure of the paper without a GPU.
